70718-the-inter-ocean-curiosity-shop-for.title: The Inter Ocean Curiosity Shop For The Year 1883
70718-the-inter-ocean-curiosity-shop-for.creator: Unknown
70718-the-inter-ocean-curiosity-shop-for.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. _Answer._—Torquato Tasso, the unfortunate Italian poet, was born in 1544. With the intention of practicing law he studied at Naples, Rome, and afterward at Bergamo. The wonderful popularity of his first poem, “Rinaldo,” written when only 18 years old, led him to abandon jurisprudence and devote himself entirely to literary pursuits. This production was a lively epic composed of twelve cantos, full of the romance of mediæval times.

arxiv-2010-09641.title: DIME: An Online Tool for the Visual Comparison of Cross-Modal Retrieval Models
arxiv-2010-09641.creator: Tony Zhao, Jaeyoung Choi, Gerald Friedland
arxiv-2010-09641.description: Abstract Cross-modal retrieval relies on accurate models to retrieve relevant results for queries across modalities such as image, text, and video. In this paper, we build upon previous work by tackling the difficulty of evaluating models both quantitatively and qualitatively quickly.

arxiv-2110-13258.title: Do female physics students benefit from informal physics programs they facilitate?
arxiv-2110-13258.creator: Jessi Randolph, Jonathan Perry, Jonan Phillip Donaldson, Callie Rethman, Tatiana Erukhimova
arxiv-2110-13258.description: Abstract Gender bias, reduced sense of belonging, and lower physics self-efficacy are among the challenges faced by female students who choose to study physics. Prior studies focusing on this underrepresented group have examined the experiences and impacts of formal educational settings, leaving the impact of informal physics programs as a relatively overlooked area.

arxiv-2211-14558.title: Toward universal text-to-music retrieval
arxiv-2211-14558.description: Abstract This paper introduces effective design choices for text-to-music retrieval systems. An ideal text-based retrieval system would support various input queries such as pre-defined tags, unseen tags, and sentence-level descriptions. In reality, most previous works mainly focused on a single query type (tag or sentence) which may not generalize to another input type.

arxiv-2310-17850.title: The Barnes-Hurwitz zeta cocycle at s = 0 s=0 and Ehrhart quasi-polynomials of triangles Thanks: This work was partially supported by the Chilean FONDECYT Iniciación grant 11200482
arxiv-2310-17850.creator: Milton Espinoza
arxiv-2310-17850.description: Abstract . Following a theorem of David R. Hayes, we give a geometric interpretation of the special value at s = 0 s=0 of certain 1 1 -cocycle on PGL 2 ​ ( ℚ ) \mathrm{PGL}_{2}(\mathbb{Q}) previously introduced by the author.

arxiv-2311-12917.title: Orchard: building large cancer phylogenies using stochastic combinatorial search
arxiv-2311-12917.creator: Ethan Kulman
arxiv-2311-12917.description: Abstract Abstract Phylogenies depicting the evolutionary history of genetically heterogeneous subpopulations of cells from the same cancer, i.e., cancer phylogenies , offer valuable insights about cancer development and guide treatment strategies. Many methods exist that reconstruct cancer phylogenies using point mutations detected with bulk DNA sequencing.

arxiv-2403-09050.title: CLOAF: CoLlisiOn-Aware Human Flow
arxiv-2403-09050.creator: Andrey Davydov, Martin Engilberge, Mathieu Salzmann, Pascal Fua
arxiv-2403-09050.description: Abstract Even the best current algorithms for estimating body 3D shape and pose yield results that include body self-intersections. In this paper, we present CLOAF, which exploits the diffeomorphic nature of Ordinary Differential Equations to eliminate such self-intersections while still imposing body shape constraints.

arxiv-2506-11648.title: Effect of converging shape of container on the velocity of impact-induced focused liquid jet Journal: International Journal of Multiphase Flow
arxiv-2506-11648.creator: Hiroya Watanabe, Hiroaki Kusuno, Yoshiyuki Tagawa
arxiv-2506-11648.description: Abstract We investigated the effect of container shape on the behavior of the impact-induced focused liquid jets by dropping a converging-shaped container (e.g., Kjeldahl flask) partially filled with liquid onto a floor to develop a method for increasing the jet velocity.

arxiv-2508-11930.title: Mn 4 Al 11 : A Half-Semimetal Candidate with Anomalous Electronic Behaviors
arxiv-2508-11930.creator: Shanshan Han, Rongsheng Li, Xingxing Jiang, Ming Lu, Shuxiang Xu, Jiang Zeng, Dong Wu, Nanlin Wang
arxiv-2508-11930.description: Abstract Half-semimetals, characterized by their spin-polarized electronic states, hold significant promise for spintronic applications but remain scarce due to stringent electronic and magnetic criteria. Through a combination of transport measurements and optical spectroscopy, we investigated the intermetallic compound Mn 4 Al 11 , which features an exceptionally low carrier concentration and undergoes a magnetic phase transition near 68 K.

arxiv-2510-04401.title: Your Vision-Language Model Can’t Even Count to 20: Exposing the Failures of VLMs in Compositional Counting
arxiv-2510-04401.creator: Xuyang Guo and Zekai Huang and Zhenmei Shi and Zhao Song and Jiahao Zhang
arxiv-2510-04401.description: Abstract Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have become a central focus of today’s AI community, owing to their impressive abilities gained from training on large-scale vision-language data from the Web. These models have demonstrated strong performance across diverse tasks, including image understanding, video understanding, complex visual reasoning, and embodied AI.

arxiv-2601-20257.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Jinren Ding, Xuejian Xu, Shen Jiang, Zhitong Hao, Jinhui Yang, Peng Jiang. Decision Transformer (DT) shows promise for generative auto-bidding by capturing temporal dependencies, but suffers from two critical limitations: insufficient cross-correlation modeling among state, action, and return-to-go (RTG) sequences, and indiscriminate learning of optimal/suboptimal behaviors.

plos-pone-0004591.title: Bird-Like Anatomy, Posture, and Behavior Revealed by an Early Jurassic Theropod Dinosaur Resting Trace
plos-pone-0004591.creator: Andrew R. C. Milner, Jerald D. Harris, Martin G. Lockley et al.
plos-pone-0004591.description: PLOS ONE research article. Fossil tracks made by non-avian theropod dinosaurs commonly reflect the habitual bipedal stance retained in living birds. Only rarely-captured behaviors, such as crouching, might create impressions made by the hands. Such tracks provide valuable information concerning the often p

pmc-10601150.title: Usefulness of FAPα assessment in bronchoalveolar lavage as a marker of fibrogenesis: results of a preclinical study and first report in patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis
pmc-10601150.creator: Philomène Lavis, Julien Pingitore, Gilles Doumont, Ani Garabet, Gaetan Van Simaeys, Simon Lacroix, Nicolas Passon, Christophe Van Heymbeek, Coraline De Maeseneire, Justine Allard, Amandine Collin, François Huaux, Christine Decaestecker, Isabelle Salmon, Serge Goldman, Alessandra Kupper Cardozo, Benj
pmc-10601150.description: BackgroundFibroblast activation protein-α (FAPα) is a marker of activated fibroblasts that can be selectively targeted by an inhibitor (FAPI) and visualised by PET/CT imaging. We evaluated whether the measurement of FAPα in bronchoalveolar lavage fluids (BALF) and the uptake of FAPI by PET/CT could be used as biomarkers of fibrogenesis.

pmc-11389422.title: Microplastics caused embryonic growth retardation and placental dysfunction in pregnant mice by activating GRP78/IRE1α/JNK axis induced apoptosis and endoplasmic reticulum stress
pmc-11389422.creator: Jun Bai, Yuzeng Wang, Siwei Deng, Ying Yang, Sheng Chen, Zhenlong Wu
pmc-11389422.description: Microplastics (MPs), a brand-new class of worldwide environmental pollutant, have received a lot of attention. MPs are consumed by both humans and animals through water, food chain and other ways, which may cause potential health risks. However, the effects of MPs on embryonic development, especially placental function, and its related mechanisms still need to be further studied.

pmc-11456557.title: Hematological and performance adaptations to altitude training (2,320 m) in elite middle-distance and distance swimmers
pmc-11456557.creator: Iñigo Mujika, Nicolas Bourdillon, Irina Zelenkova, Frédéric Vergnoux, Grégoire P. Millet
pmc-11456557.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). PurposeElite swimmers often schedule altitude training camps ahead of major events in an attempt to maximize performance. However, the relationships between altitude-induced hematological changes, markers of training adaptation, and performance changes in such context are unclear.

pmc-11487322.title: Resilience after adversity: an umbrella review of adversity protective factors and resilience-promoting interventions
pmc-11487322.creator: Biruk Beletew Abate, Ashenafi Kibret Sendekie, Abay Woday Tadesse, Tesfaye Engdaw, Ayelign Mengesha, Alemu Birara Zemariam, Addis Wondmagegn Alamaw, Gebremeskel Abebe, Molla Azmeraw
pmc-11487322.description: IntroductionResilience is the dynamic adaptive process of maintaining or recovering mental health from stressors, such as trauma, challenging life circumstances, critical transitions, or physical illnesses. Resilience after adversity can be fostered through protective factors and the implementation of interventions that promote resilience.

pmc-12008320.title: Effect of Multi-component Exercise Program on Functional Performance in Breast Cancer Survivors
pmc-12008320.creator: Sandeep Babasaheb Shinde, Pooja Prakash Jain, Anand Gudur, Sanjay Kumar Patil, Ravindra V Shinde
pmc-12008320.description: Background: Breast surgery, radiation, chemotherapy and modified radical mastectomy (MRM) may cause long-term side effects such as decreased muscle strength, pulmonary function, cardio-respiratory fitness (CRF), altered body fat distribution and poor sleep quality. These short- and long-term repercussions have an enormous effect on physical functioning in this population.

pmc-12435658.title: Construction and validation of a prognostic model based on mitochondria-associated endoplasmic reticulum membranes gene signature in LUAD patients
pmc-12435658.creator: Qichen Zhang, Caihong Fu, Shasha Liu, Yue Leng, Ling Duan, Na Wang, Longxia Zhang, Hui Qiao
pmc-12435658.description: BackgroundMitochondrial-associated endoplasmic reticulum membranes (MAM) are implicated in various malignancies, but their prognostic value in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) remains underexplored.MethodsThe Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) and GeneCards databases provided LUAD patient data and MAM-related genes. Differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were identified using the “Limma” package.

pmc-12784484.title: Evaluation of the validity and reliability of the Persian version of the refugee post-migration stress scale
pmc-12784484.creator: Soore khaki, Fariba Hosseinzadegan, Abbas Ebadi, Seyed Qasem Mousavi, Amir Reza Tavakoli, Salman Barasteh
pmc-12784484.description: BackgroundRefugees usually face stressful events both in the destination country and during migration. To date, no tool has been designed to reflect the post-migration stress of Persian-speaking refugees on the basis of their current life conditions. Therefore, this study was conducted to determine the psychometric characteristics of the Persian version of the Refugee Post-migration Stress Scale (RPMS).

pmc-13105923.title: Cloning, structural and functional characterization of the ABCB1 transporter of the Eurasian bullfinch (Pyrrhula pyrrhula)
pmc-13105923.creator: Katharina Heilmann, Luise Charlotte Kempf, Lisa Siegl, Melanie Hamann, Michael Lierz, Joachim Geyer
pmc-13105923.description: Suspected ivermectin hypersensitivity has been reported in the Eurasian bullfinch and some related passerine birds. However, the underlying cause and pharmacological mechanism have not been systematically investigated. In mammals, ivermectin hypersensitivity in dogs and cats has been linked to mutations in the ABCB1 gene, which encodes the P-glycoprotein drug efflux transporter.

pmc-13147114.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A989 RISK FACTORS FOR FUTILE RECANALIZATION AFTER ENDOVASCULAR TREATMENT IN LARGE-CORE ISCHEMIC STROKE: INSIGHTS FROM REAL-WORLD CLINICAL PRACTICE
pmc-13147114.creator: Hang Tran, Quoc Trung Nguyen, Khang Nguyen, Thien Le, Dung Bach, Lanh Nguyen, Huy Thang Nguyen
pmc-13147114.description: Background and aimsEndovascular treatment (EVT) is the standard of care for acute ischemic stroke (AIS) with large vessel occlusion (LVO), including patients with large-core infarcts. However, futile recanalization (FR)—successful angiographic reperfusion without functional recovery—remains a major challenge. This study aimed to identify risk factors for FR in patients with large-core AIS undergoing EVT.

pmc-13188281.title: Prevalence of nontuberculous mycobacteria isolates and pulmonary disease from respiratory tract samples in persons investigated for presumed tuberculosis from three West African countries, an analysis of three prospective cohort studies
pmc-13188281.creator: Elizabeth Tabitha Abbew, Souleymane Mahamadou Bassirou, Isiyaku Ahmadu, Juliana Boampomaa Adu, Roger Laryea, Rita Patricia Frimpong Amenyo, Felix Sorvor, Yaw Adusi Poku, Dorcas Obiri-Yeboah, Tom Decroo, Lutgarde Lynen, Natalie Lorent, Leen Rigouts
pmc-13188281.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundIn West Africa, the isolation of nontuberculous mycobacteria (NTM) is increasingly reported among individuals evaluated for tuberculosis (TB). However, the clinical relevance of NTM detection from respiratory tract samples remains unclear, creating uncertainty for clinicians when NTM are identified.

pmc-13267782.title: Human XIRP1 is a new podosome protein targeting cytosolic bacteria as part of the IFN-γ defense program
pmc-13267782.creator: Rodolfo Urbano, Alexander S Low, Aglaia Ntokou, Eui-Soon Park, Kyle Tretina, Alexandru Tunaru, Ryan G Gaudet, John D MacMicking
pmc-13267782.description: Interferon-gamma (IFN-γ) is a powerful transactivating signal eliciting hundreds of IFN-stimulated genes (ISGs) in humans to help combat infection. Most ISGs remain uncharacterized, and here we searched for actin-binding candidates that could potentially target intracellular pathogens to block their spread or promote immune cell migration into infected tissues.

pmc-13314905.title: The role of mothers and fathers in children’s health care use
pmc-13314905.creator: Toni Mora, Teresa Bago d’Uva, Pilar García-Gómez, Manuel Flores
pmc-13314905.description: We use rich longitudinal administrative medical records to examine the separate roles of mothers and fathers in children’s health care use. We do so distinguishing between different types of care and child sex. Overall, we find limited evidence of an association between parents’ education and their children’s health care use.
